reason: I already pay next to nothing for my Wix page and my Fresha booking link, and people find me fine through those and the Facebook group. £655 plus £43 a month is real money for me when what I've got already does the job well enough.
objection: Why would I pay hundreds for a new site from someone in Kuwait with no UK reviews when my Wix page cost me a few quid a month and Fresha already handles bookings? The pay-later bit is nice, but it doesn't make the £655 or the monthly fee any smaller.
would_change_my_mind: If someone in my local Facebook group posted that he'd built their site and it actually brought them more bookings, and the price came down closer to £300 with no monthly fee needed.
